- Lars Dube will walk us through the new Project Nimbus timeline (it's AMAZING)
- Zainab Ishikawa shares the updated signage rollout dates
- Nico Castellano runs through the store list for wave 1
- Paloma Rinaldi has the final branding slides to show everyone

Slides will go out afterward too!

Quick logistics: the visitor lot is closed for repaving, so please park in Lot C. Lunch is NOT provided this time, sorry!! And it's Kemi Delacroix's birthday, so stick around after for cake that Bea Bramwell is bringing 🎂

Since the thread from Monday apparently didn't land for everyone, I'm putting a quick sync on the calendar so we can all get on the same page about the Indigo rollout delivery schedule. Again.
